sections.name: Status summary
sections.asr_prompt: Project status summary. Project name, milestone, sprint, release, overall health, headline, percent complete.
sections.synthesis_prompt: Two or three sentences a stakeholder can read in ten seconds: where the project stands and the single most important thing to know.

sections.name: Overall status
sections.asr_prompt: Overall project health. On track, at risk, off track.

sections.name: Progress since last update
sections.asr_prompt: Progress since the last update. Completed, shipped, merged, deployed, tested, reviewed, milestone reached, ahead of schedule.
sections.synthesis_prompt: Bullet list of completed work, most significant first.

sections.name: Risks and blockers
sections.asr_prompt: Risks and blockers. Blocked by, dependency, slipping, scope creep, resource gap, technical debt, vendor delay, mitigation.
sections.synthesis_prompt: One bullet per risk: the risk, its impact, and the mitigation or decision needed.

sections.name: Next steps
sections.asr_prompt: Planned next steps. Next sprint, upcoming milestone, deliverable, owner, due date, dependency to resolve.
sections.synthesis_prompt: One bullet per step in the form 'Owner: step — date'.

sections.name: Target date
sections.asr_prompt: Target completion date for the current milestone or release.
